_note: Voice: Brian (ElevenLabs stock, male narrator). PLACEHOLDER text: plain language for senior non-technical staffing team (no jargon). Covers the 4 problem dimensions: no standard, hard matching, unexplained decisions, missing info. start = second in the screen recording, ~2.6 words/second. Align with the deck once the demo exists.

segments.text: Today, putting the right person on the right project depends on gut feeling, spreadsheets and phone calls.
Meet [PRODUCT]. A staffing manager opens a new project and asks one question: who fits best?
Every person is described the same way, with the same skills and levels, so profiles can finally be compared.
In seconds, [PRODUCT] suggests the best people for the project, and says in plain words why each one fits.
Missing information is shown upfront, so the manager knows what to check before deciding.
[KEY METRIC]. Faster, fairer and explainable staffing, built on NTT DATA's own data.
